# /proc/<pid>/cgroup lines and what node mode makes of them (research R9).
# Format: <kind> <pod id or -> <container id or -> <line>
#   kind: container | pause | host | own (the helper's own processes)
# The kind lines were read from a hostPID busybox pod on kind (containerd,
# systemd driver, cgroup v2) on 2026-10-29. Paths are relative to that pod's
# cgroup namespace, hence the /.. prefixes. Static pods (etcd, apiserver...)
# carry a 32-hex config hash instead of a UID; the mirror pod's
# kubernetes.io/config.mirror annotation holds the same hash.
